title: JSON schema $ref values contain unencoded < and > (#/definitions/StringM<N>), so strict validators reject the schemas

target.versions_affected: 30.0.0 and main ebec5fb (the schemas in xdr-json/); @stellar/stellar-xdr-json 30.0.0 schema() (range not established)

severity_basis: schema_name() of StringM<MAX> returns StringM<N>, which schemars 0.8 uses as the $ref without encoding; < and > are not allowed unencoded in a URI fragment, so a validator that checks uri-reference refuses 131 of the 477 published schemas. Lenient validators accept them.
caps_note: No CAP applies: the JSON schemas of SEP-51 XDR-JSON, not a protocol change.

entries.expected: the published JSON schemas compile in a strict JSON Schema validator
entries.observed: No corpus entry covers the JSON schemas. By hand on 30.0.0: 131 of the 477 files in xdr-json/ hold 443 $ref values of the form #/definitions/StringM<N>, which the jsonschema crate refuses as not a uri-reference.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's program on stellar-xdr 30.0.0 with schemars 0.8 and jsonschema 0.61: the Memo schema and xdr-json/Memo.json are refused with '"#/definitions/StringM<28>" is not a "uri-reference"'; percent-encoding only the $ref values makes all 477 files compile.
evidence.expected_basis: A $ref must be a URI reference, and < and > are not allowed unencoded in a URI fragment (RFC 3986 section 3.5).

reproduction.method: Checked again on 2026-11-18 in the published stellar-xdr 30.0.0 crate: 131 of 477 xdr-json files with 443 $ref values containing '<' (src/generated.rs formats StringM<{MAX}>). The strict validator was not re-run.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/rs-stellar-xdr/issues/626; this record restates the public issue.

Upstream: the maintainer closed the issue on 2026-11-19 after a fix was merged on main in commit f6c69ff0 (the generated schemas inline StringM, so none of the 477 files in xdr-json/ holds a $ref with < or >, checked at that commit); no stellar-xdr release after 30.0.0 includes it yet.
Upstream state refreshed: GitHub records the issue's closure reason as duplicate; the fix of commit f6c69ff0 is on main, and no stellar-xdr release after 30.0.0 includes it yet.
